title: BUGFIX — Move ts-node and typescript to production dependencies
rationale: deploy-hetzner.sh runs 'npm ci --omit=dev' on the Hetzner VPS. ts-node and typescript were devDependencies, so they would NOT be installed on Hetzner. All PM2 processes (achiri-api, achiri-telegram, and all scs001 cron scripts) use 'npx ts-node' to run TypeScript directly. Without ts-node on Hetzner, every PM2 process would fail to start. Fix: move ts-node (^10.9.2) and typescript (^5.7.0) from devDependencies to dependencies in package.json.

tasks.description: Move ts-node@^10.9.2 and typescript@^5.7.0 from devDependencies to dependencies in package.json. This ensures 'npm ci --omit=dev' on Hetzner installs both packages, allowing 'npx ts-node' to work for all PM2 processes.
